# Chuck Reynolds

> Works with founders, engineering leads, and go-to-market teams on products
> end to end: how they're built, how teams ship them, and how real people use
> them. Systems and process, AI enablement for teams, growth and go-to-market.
> Open to fractional and project work. Currently Staff Product Manager, Growth
> at Wikimedia Enterprise.

This is a single-page personal site. The homepage contains the complete
content; every other link here points off-site. Contact: hello@chuckreynolds.com

## Main

- [Chuck Reynolds](https://chuckreynolds.com/): Bio, current work, background, contact.

## Work

- [Wikimedia Enterprise](https://enterprise.wikimedia.com): Bulk data, retrieval, and grounding APIs for Wikipedia and sibling projects.
- [Structured Wikipedia on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/wikimedia/structured-wikipedia): Public dataset published from the structured-contents pipeline.
- [Vuurr](https://vuurr.com): Digital intelligence firm. Partner since 2011.
- [Rynoweb](https://rynoweb.com): Web tech consultancy, running since 2000.
- [OrbitHull](https://orbithull.com): Modular cargo containers for orbital tasking.
